reviews.review: Having this game on my wish list for a long time and then finally seeing a nice sale spurred me to try this out. I cannot give this game a good review and maybe that is my problem...and maybe I am late to party, but this game seemed painfully slow. I finished the tutorial fine but failed the first mission because I couldn't zip line up out of a hole fast enough to return to the pod...so...30+ minutes wasted. I guess I could attempt the multiplayer venture...but I fear that with the given length of missions and the pace of them, it could ultimately lock me into a game I don't necessarily enjoy. I would recommend it for the destructible environment...but I just cant see it as being much more than that.

Good game, if you have friends to play with, easy recommend, even by yourself it's great fun.

On of the best hoard shooters out there. Great weapon and class balance, you always feel like you're missing out without one of the classes, but never feel like not having a class will cause you to fail. The difficulty curve is a little too steep, but good, and the developers actually fight to earn your money instead of locking content off so you feel like you have to. I own most of the DLC, not for the DLC, but because I want to support this company and their practices. The season pass is not the boring thing that passes for season passes these days and contains more than enough to make you want to unlock it all, but never makes you feel like you HAVE to unlock it all. Timegating is minimal, which is the only slightly negative thing I have to say about it but I honestly never have enough time to do it all anyway, so the gating just gives me things to work on, never slows me down.

At the end of the day, solid 9/10, would yell at the programmer that made MOLLY again.

P.S. - they have a community art event going on where they will actually pay for the production rights for the art they like. 100% approve this.
